subtitle: Cross-reading of September 14, 2026, confirmed reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT (22:44 UTC), with the presidential book at USD 149.82M. All five monitored contracts received a new price in this round: winner, first-round runner-up, first-round third place, impeachment at the Supreme Court and Senate majority. On the poll side, TWO national polls released on the same Sep 14 come in: BTG/Nexus, with fieldwork from Sep 11 to 13, and Genial/Quaest, with fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 45.50% (vol USD 11.01M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT, a fall of 2.00pp against the price confirmed on Sep 13, and 22.00pp below his series high, of 67.50% on Aug 16. In the first-round runner-up contract he is at 23.75%, up 1.75pp. POLL: 42% in the first round and 47% to 46% in the runoff pair against Flávio Bolsonaro in the BTG/Nexus poll of Sep 14, and 36% in the first round and 40% to 42% in the same pair in the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14. Both runoff differences fit inside the 2.0 margin.
fortes: In both national polls of Sep 14 he leads the first round by 5 points, a distance that does not fit inside two 2.0 margins: 42% to 37% in BTG/Nexus and 36% to 31% in Genial/Quaest.

In BTG/Nexus he is ahead again in the runoff pair against Flávio Bolsonaro, by 47% to 46%, after 45% to 46% in the house’s round of Sep 08, and he wins the other four pairs it tested, three of them outside the margin: 47% to 41% against Ronaldo Caiado, 49% to 38% against Romeu Zema and 48% to 37% against Renan Santos.
The BTG/Nexus poll of Sep 14 measures government approval at 47% against 49% disapproval, compared with 45% and 50% in the same house’s round of Sep 08.
fracos: In the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14 he is behind in the runoff pair against Flávio Bolsonaro, 40% to 42%, inside the margin, and within the house itself the pair came out 42% to 41% for him on Sep 02, tied at 41% on Sep 07 and now goes to his opponent.
In the winner contract he falls 2.00pp, to 45.50%, for the second straight day, and the spread to the leader widens from 2.15pp to 6.45pp.
In the first-round runner-up contract he rises 1.75pp, to 23.75%, which measures a greater chance of finishing second, with Flávio Bolsonaro at 75.50% there.
The Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14 measures government approval at 43% against 50% disapproval, the same figures as the house’s round of Sep 07.
candidates.analise: September 14 brings the two measurements in directions that do not add up. In the winner contract he fell 2.00pp and stands at 45.50% (vol USD 11.01M), confirmed reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT, a second straight day of decline, and the spread to the leader widened from 2.15pp to 6.45pp, with the opponent rising 2.30pp. In the confirmed reading of 13:02 on the same day he had not yet moved against Sep 13, so the whole fall came in the afternoon. In the first-round runner-up contract he rose 1.75pp, to 23.75%, in the same direction measured by an independent book. On the poll side, two national polls released on the same day came in, and they AGREE on the first round and DISAGREE on the sign of the runoff: BTG/Nexus, with fieldwork from Sep 11 to 13, gives him 42% to 37% in the first round and 47% to 46% in the pair, and Genial/Quaest, with fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13, gives 36% to 31% in the first round and 40% to 42% in the pair. Both runoff differences fit inside each house’s 2.0 margin, so what both measure in the pair is a statistical tie with opposite signs, and the dashboard records both without choosing. Within each house the pair also moved in opposite directions: in BTG/Nexus it went from 45% to 46% on Sep 08 to 47% to 46% now, and in Genial/Quaest from 41% to 41% on Sep 07 to 40% to 42%. The week continues with ten national polls scheduled for release between Sep 15 and 18, five of them on the same Sep 17.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 51.95% (vol USD 10.68M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT, a rise of 2.30pp against the price confirmed on Sep 13, and 3.15pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10. In the first-round runner-up contract he is at 75.50%, down 1.50pp. POLL: 37% in the first round and 46% to 47% in the runoff pair against Lula in the BTG/Nexus poll of Sep 14, and 31% in the first round and 42% to 40% in the same pair in the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14.
fortes: In the winner contract he rises 2.30pp, to 51.95%, and the spread to the runner-up widens from 2.15pp to 6.45pp.
In the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14 he is ahead in the runoff pair against Lula, by 42% to 40%, inside the margin, and within the house the pair went from 41% to 41% on Sep 07 to 42% to 40%.
In the first round both national polls of the day measure him above each house’s previous round: from 35% to 37% in BTG/Nexus and from 29% to 31% in Genial/Quaest.
In the first-round runner-up contract he falls 1.50pp, to 75.50%, which measures a lower chance of finishing second.
fracos: In both national polls of the day he trails by 5 points in the first round, a distance that does not fit inside two 2.0 margins: 37% to 42% in BTG/Nexus and 31% to 36% in Genial/Quaest.
In the BTG/Nexus poll of Sep 14 he loses the runoff pair by 46% to 47%, after having appeared ahead by 46% to 45% in the same house’s round of Sep 08.
The 51.95% sits 3.15pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10.
candidates.analise: September 14 interrupts two straight days of decline in the winner contract. He rose 2.30pp and stands at 51.95% (vol USD 10.68M), confirmed reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT, 3.15pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10, and the spread to the runner-up widened from 2.15pp to 6.45pp with both sides moving. In the confirmed reading of 13:02 on the same day his rise was 1.10pp and the opponent had not moved, so 1.20pp of the rise and the opponent’s whole fall came in the afternoon. In the first-round runner-up contract he fell 1.50pp and stands at 75.50%. On the poll side, both national polls of the day measure him 2 points above each house’s previous round in the first round and still 5 points behind, and they disagree on the runoff pair: Genial/Quaest puts him ahead by 42% to 40% and BTG/Nexus behind by 46% to 47%, both inside the margin. The order of the facts is measured and the link to the price is not, because the book is arbitraged continuously and no single reading separates one motive from another.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury

POLL: 6% in the first round in the BTG/Nexus poll of Sep 14 and 7% in the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14, and he loses the runoff pair to Lula in both, by 42% to 45% and by 36% to 38%, both inside two 2.0 margins.
fortes: He remains the favourite in the first-round third-place contract, at 45.40%, ahead of Renan Santos, at 37.50%.
In both runoff pairs of the day against Lula he stays inside two 2.0 margins: 42% to 45% in BTG/Nexus and 36% to 38% in Genial/Quaest.
In Genial/Quaest the pair moved in his favour against the house’s round of Sep 07, from 35% to 39% to 36% to 38%.
fracos: Largest move of any contract on the dashboard in this round, and it is a fall: 10.20pp in the first-round third-place contract, from 55.60% to 45.40%, and the spread to the runner-up there narrows from 21.10pp to 7.90pp.
In the first round both houses measure him below each one’s previous round: from 9% to 6% in BTG/Nexus and from 8% to 7% in Genial/Quaest.
In BTG/Nexus the runoff pair against Lula flipped against the house’s round of Sep 08: it went from 45% to 43% in his favour to 45% to 42% in Lula’s favour.
candidates.analise: His move in this round is the largest on the dashboard. In the first-round third-place contract he fell 10.20pp and stands at 45.40% (vol USD 196 thousand), confirmed reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT, and the spread to Renan Santos there narrowed from 21.10pp to 7.90pp, because in the same contract Renan rose 3.00pp and Ronaldo Caiado 7.00pp. It is not an extreme: in the readings recorded on Sep 09 the same contract reached 43.90%. In the winner contract he is at 0.35%. On the poll side, both national polls of the day measure him below each house’s previous round in the first round, 6% in BTG/Nexus and 7% in Genial/Quaest, and in both he loses the runoff pair to Lula inside two margins. The order of the facts is measured, the link between them is not.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 1.70% (vol USD 13.47M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT, down 0.15pp, and 37.50% in the first-round third-place contract (vol USD 307 thousand), up 3.00pp. POLL: 2% in the first round in the BTG/Nexus poll of Sep 14 and 4% in the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14, and he loses the runoff pair to Lula in both, by 37% to 48% and by 38% to 41%.
fortes: In the first-round third-place contract he rises 3.00pp, to 37.50%, after two straight days of decline there, and the spread to that contract’s favourite narrows from 21.10pp to 7.90pp.
His winner contract still holds USD 13.47M accumulated, the second-largest individual volume in the presidential book, behind only Tarcísio de Freitas’s, at USD 14.07M.
In the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14 he rises from 3% to 4% in the first round, and the pair against Lula stands at 38% to 41%, inside two 2.0 margins.
fracos: In the BTG/Nexus poll of Sep 14 he loses the runoff pair to Lula by 37% to 48%, the widest distance of the five pairs the house tested, tied with Romeu Zema’s, 38% to 49%.
In the BTG/Nexus first round he falls from 4% to 2% against the house’s round of Sep 08.
In the winner contract he eases 0.15pp and sits 0.50pp above his series floor, of 1.20% on Aug 31.
candidates.analise: In this round he moves in opposite directions in the two contracts. In the first-round third-place contract he rose 3.00pp and stands at 37.50% (vol USD 307 thousand), confirmed reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT, after two straight days of decline there, and the spread to that contract’s favourite narrowed from 21.10pp to 7.90pp because the favourite fell 10.20pp. In the winner contract he eased 0.15pp and stands at 1.70%, with USD 13.47M accumulated, the second-largest individual volume in the presidential book. On the poll side, the two houses of the day measure him in different directions: BTG/Nexus at 2% in the first round, two points below its previous round, and Genial/Quaest at 4%, one above its own, and both put him behind Lula in the runoff pair.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema

Caiado loses the runoff pair to Lula outside the margin in BTG/Nexus and inside it in Genial/Quaest, and Zema loses outside the margin in both.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% (vol USD 7.54M) in the WINNER contract, reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT, at the book floor. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and the two national polls of Sep 14 do not test him in a presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: He is not tested as a presidential candidate in the national polls of the window, and neither BTG/Nexus nor Genial/Quaest of Sep 14 tests him, so there is no poll reading to cross with the price.
haddad.fracos: The contract remains open under his name by inheritance of the market's design, not by a declared candidacy, and the panel keeps the line only so the residual price is not read as a signal.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.15% (vol USD 7.30M) in the WINNER contract, reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the first-round THIRD-PLACE contract he is at 0.75%, in a book of USD 54 thousand. He has 1% in the first round in both national polls of Sep 14.
zema.fortes: Up 0.05pp in the first-round THIRD-PLACE contract, from 0.70% to 0.75%, his only move in this round.
zema.fracos: ⚠️ IN THE RUNOFF PAIRS HE IS THE WIDEST GAP IN BOTH HOUSES OF THE DAY: 38% to 49% in BTG/Nexus, tied with Renan Santos’s, and 33% to 45% in Genial/Quaest, that is 11 and 12 points of distance. candidates.analise: The block of low-priced names has the second-largest move of the round, and it is in the first-round third-place contract: Ronaldo Caiado rises 7.00pp and reaches 15.50% (vol USD 129 thousand), a third straight day of gains there. It is not an extreme for that contract, which in the readings recorded on Aug 30 and 31 reached 45.50% and 45.00% for him. In the winner contracts all three are flat, Caiado and Zema at 0.15% and Haddad at 0.05%, the latter with USD 7.54M accumulated, which shows that large volume and a floor price coexist without contradiction. On the poll side, the two national polls of the day diverge on Caiado in the runoff pair: Genial/Quaest puts him 2 points from Lula, 39% to 41%, inside the margin, and BTG/Nexus 6 points, 41% to 47%, outside it. On Zema both agree on 1% in the first round and on a double-digit distance in the pair.
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado RISES 7.00pp in the first-round third-place contract, to 15.50%, the second-largest move on the dashboard in this round.
In the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14, Caiado loses the runoff pair to Lula by just 39% to 41%, inside the margin, and rises from 3% to 4% in the first round against the house’s round of Sep 07.
Romeu Zema rises 0.05pp in the first-round third-place contract, to 0.75%.

In the winner contracts the three remain below two tenths: Caiado at 0.15%, Zema at 0.15% and Haddad at 0.05%.
Fernando Haddad is not tested in a presidential scenario by the two national polls of Sep 14, and his contract pays the book floor even with USD 7.54M accumulated.

cruzamento: 📈 THE WINNER CONTRACT SPREAD WIDENED 4.30pp, AND BOTH SIDES MOVED: Flávio Bolsonaro rose from 49.65% to 51.95% (vol USD 10.68M) and Lula fell from 47.50% to 45.50% (vol USD 11.01M), confirmed reading of Sep 14, 19:44 BRT, against the confirmed reading of Sep 13. The distance went from 2.15pp to 6.45pp. ⚠️ Most of that came in the afternoon: in the confirmed reading of 13:02 on the same day the spread stood at 3.25pp, with Lula flat, and this reading replaces it. Neither price is an extreme: 51.95% sits 3.15pp below Flávio’s high, of 55.10% on Sep 10, and 45.50% sits 22.00pp below Lula’s high, of 67.50% on Aug 16. 🔁 THE FIRST-ROUND RUNNER-UP CONTRACT MOVED IN THE SAME DIRECTION: Flávio Bolsonaro fell 1.50pp there, to 75.50%, and Lula rose 1.75pp, to 23.75%, and the two books are independent. 🗳️ TWO NATIONAL POLLS CAME OUT ON THE SAME SEP 14, AND THEY AGREE ON THE FIRST ROUND AND DISAGREE ON THE SIGN OF THE RUNOFF. BTG/Nexus, with fieldwork from Sep 11 to 13, gives Lula 42% to 37% in the first round and 47% to 46% in the pair; Genial/Quaest, with fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13, gives Lula 36% to 31% in the first round and Flávio Bolsonaro 42% to 40% in the pair. The 5 points of the first round repeat in both houses, and both runoff differences fit inside each one’s 2.0 margin, so in the pair what both measure is a statistical tie with opposite signs. 🔁 WITHIN EACH HOUSE THE PAIR MOVED IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS: in BTG/Nexus it went from 46% to 45% for Flávio on Sep 08 to 47% to 46% for Lula, and in Genial/Quaest from 41% to 41% on Sep 07 to 42% to 40% for Flávio. And the two agree on something else: in both the runner-up rises 2 points in the first round against the house’s previous round. ⭐ THE LARGEST MOVE OF THE ROUND IS IN THE FIRST-ROUND THIRD-PLACE CONTRACT: Augusto Cury fell 10.20pp, from 55.60% to 45.40%, Ronaldo Caiado rose 7.00pp, from 8.50% to 15.50%, and Renan Santos rose 3.00pp, to 37.50%, and the spread of that contract’s favourite narrowed from 21.10pp to 7.90pp. None of the three prices is an extreme: in the readings recorded on Sep 09 Cury’s contract reached 43.90%, and Caiado’s reached 45.50% on Aug 30. 🏛️ THE SUPREME COURT IMPEACHMENT CONTRACT ROSE 0.65pp and stands at 5.25% (vol USD 91 thousand), 20.85pp below the series high, of 26.10% on Sep 11, and 3.15pp above the floor, of 2.10% on Jun 8. 📌 IN THE NEWS, the Supreme Court’s proceedings moved on the eve of the Sep 15 session: on Sep 14 the Federal Police delivered to the offices of Cristiano Zanin and Gilmar Mendes the full data extracted from Daniel Vorcaro’s phone, which the two had requested directly from the police, and André Mendonça, the rapporteur, opened access to Pet 15.645, on Banco Master’s payment network, at the request of Edson Fachin, after a request by Alexandre de Moraes and a favourable opinion from the Prosecutor General’s Office. On the same day the Federal Police carried out Operation Transparência 3, authorized by Flávio Dino, on suspected influence peddling before the higher courts, with congressman Cezinha de Madureira as the main target and no arrest. The order of the facts is measured, the link between them is not.
